measurement: Real Arcade Core, default seven states; identical read-only observers; all fixed seeds retained. Candidate offers count unique real people returned by the production opportunity reader. Baseline feature is absent, so actual offers are zero. Static adult-kin observation is a separate, conservative age18-64 diagnostic.
limitations: Shared seeds do not imply identical subsequent RNG paths. No probability or troop-cap tuning to match event counts.
Age snapshots describe surviving ordinary real Users across these worlds, excluding military/royal identities; they are not a birth cohort or a mortality experiment.
Controlled career/deposition regressions verify reachability, not natural event rates.
